reported_value: Comparator-dependent models showed that the AF35 association was partly shared with broader immune programs, with the strongest dependence on cytotoxicity in ERP117672 (figure 5G,H). In the non-ICI GSE104580 TACE cohort, AF35 remained positive in unadjusted and broad-immune-residual contrasts while PTPN22 was weak or null (figure 5I). Together, these results place AF35 within a broader immune-engaged treatment state rather than an ICI-exclusive response signal. Comparison with the reconstructable published 20-gene interferon-stimulated program showed partial molecular overlap and a positive but uncertain conditional AF35 direction (online supplemental figure S15; online supplemental table S14).
